description: This file defines the EmailSubscriberModel class, which is a PHP model class used to represent email subscriber data in the OrangeHRM Admin API. It implements serialization and normalization features via traits and interfaces, and is mapped to an EmailSubscriber entity.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberModel
classes.description: A model class representing an email subscriber for the Admin API, facilitating serialization and API interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an EmailSubscriber entity and sets up property filters and attribute mappings.
